title: Cobalt Blue: Payments and Transfers Explained
summary: Explains Cobalt Blue payment/transfer options: standard ACH (no fee), same-day ACH (fee $0.00, subject to submission/approval cutoffs), outgoing domestic wires ($20.00), and incoming domestic wires (5/month free, additional may be fee). Also covers tracking via activity feed and referral bonus requirements ($7,500 qualifying deposit within 90 days; eligibility when earliest-opened Rho-Bank checking reaches 60 days).
faqs: What fees apply to standard ACH vs same-day ACH transfers?
Are same-day ACH transfers really charged $0.00, and what cutoffs affect same-day processing?
What is the fee for outgoing domestic wire transfers, and when should I use wires vs ACH?
How many incoming domestic wire transfers per month are free, and could additional incoming wires cost fees?
Where can I check a transfer’s status or confirmations?
What are the requirements to earn a referral bonus (deposit amount, time window, and account-age eligibility)?
